natural_language_instruction: Spawn in survival mode with a stone pickaxe in your starting inventory. Explore the surface and any nearby caves to find coal_ore deposits. Mine at least 5 coal ore blocks (yielding raw coal). Return to the surface with at least 5 coal in your inventory and bot.health > 0. Avoid lava and creepers; bring torches if you have them.
success_criteria: bot is at surface y-level (y >= 60) at end
